expected.title: Energy-controlled large free subsemigroups inside twofold products for acylindrical actions on hyperbolic length spaces
expected.author: Rémi Coulon; Markus Steenbock
expected.difficulty_reason: Acylindricity alone does not select a large strongly reduced alphabet from a finite set with controlled energy. The authors construct an appropriate quasi-center and separately solve the diffuse-energy and concentrated-energy cases by Gromov-product selection and acylindrical packing. Those new extraction arguments produce the precise cardinality and scale bounds before the short final case split.
